data.name: Eliora
data.gender_notes: Eliora is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Eliora is derived from the Greek word 'elios' meaning 'sun' and 'ora' meaning 'face' or 'border'. In Greek mythology, Helios, the god of the sun, was believed to be the god of light. This name signifies that the bearer's countenance reflects the light and warmth of God. The name Eliora carries the meaning “My God is light” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Eliora usually hope their child will grow to embody my god is light and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Eliora belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “My God is light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Eliora total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_hebrew.name: אליוֹרה
in_hebrew.meaning: אלוהים הוא אור שלי - אלוהים הוא מקור האור שלי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אליוֹרה הוא שם שמקורו בשפה העברית ומורכב משתי מילים: 'אל' שפירושו אלוהים, ו'אור' שפירושו אור. השם אליוֹרה ניתן לפרש כ'אלוהים הוא אור שלי' או 'אלוהים הוא מקור האור שלי'. השם נושא משמעות רוחנית עמוקה, הקושרת בין האדם לאלוהים כמקור האור והחיים.

in_greek.name: Ἠλιόρα
in_greek.meaning: Ἠλιός ἐστιν ἡ φῶς μου - οὐρανός φῶς
in_greek.long_meaning: Ἠλιόρα ὁνομάζεται ἀπὸ τὰ ἑβραϊκά, ὅπου ἡ λέξις ἀναφέρεται εἰς τὸ Θεὸν ὡς πηγήν φωτός. Ἡ ὀνομασία αὕτη εἰς τὴν Καινήν Διαθήκην οὐ φαίνεται ἀπευθείας, ἀλλὰ ἡ σημασία αὐτῆς συνδέεται μὲ τὴν πνευματικὴν φώτισην καὶ τὴν παρουσίαν τοῦ Θεοῦ εἰς τὴν ζωήν.

in_latin.name: Eliora
in_latin.meaning: Deus est lux mea - Domini est lumen
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Eliora origine hebraico, significat 'Deus est lux mea' vel 'Domini est lumen'. Hoc nomen in traditione christiana vim spiritualem habet, scilicet connexionem hominis cum Deo ut fonte luminis et vitae. In primo usu, nomen hoc potuit esse inspiratum scripturis hebraicis.
